title: New Insight driver fails to deliver boluses
symptom: Boluses are recorded in AAPS on the phone as delivered, but the pump bolus history is empty. The animation in AAPS app was suspiciously fast (zero connection time, no sounds from the pump), and the pump bolus history showed no new boluses after switching to AAPS 3.3.0.0.
fix: Reinstalling AAPS 3.3.0.0 and retrying the bolus worked; the issue was resolved after restarting bluetooth. The user concluded it was a false alarm.
evidence_quote: So I reinstalled AAPS 3.3.0.0 and this time it seems to be OK. Sorry for the false alarm.
